answer_1.quote: How to effectively learn dialog strategies is an enduring challenge for open-domain multi-turn conversation generation.

answer_2.quote: We propose the following metrics. ... Dist-i calculates the ratio of distinct i-gram ... We use Dist-2 to measure the diversity of generated responses.

answer_4.quote: We ask three annotators to judge the quality of each dialog (at multi-turn level) or utterance pair (at single-turn level) for each model. Notice that model identifiers are masked during evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rate each dialog or utterance on criteria such as global coherence, local appropriateness, and informativeness.
